title: Machine learning-enhanced multi-trait genomic prediction for optimizing cannabinoid profiles in cannabis
summary: Genomic prediction models linked SNP profiles to measured cannabinoid traits across cannabis accessions, with trait-specific predictive performance and associated loci. The result is limited to the reported samples, datasets, and assays; broader transfer and downstream utility were not established.
